name: PT Lima Dua Lima Tiga Tbk
summary: PT Lima Dua Lima Tiga Tbk, founded in 2011, is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. This company primarily operates within the hospitality industry, notably managing the popular "Lucy In The Sky" rooftop bar and restaurant located in Jakarta. Its business operations are structured across three distinct divisions: Food, Beverage, and Other services.
